verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a cubic free tier reached by signing in with a personal account. The closest item, connecting an existing ChatGPT Plus/Pro or Claude Code subscription for local reviews, is an adjacent feature: it relies on paid third-party subscriptions and does not grant free-tier access from cubic. Flex capacity mentions included reviewed-line capacity but nothing free or tied to a personal account.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sign in with a personal account to get free-tier access without managing API keys
